intro: WRIGGLE. is an encounter with an excitable young slime that loves to dance until it runs out of energy. To revive and befriend the creature, an adventurer must fetch a special batch of nutritious sludge from the canals of the Undercity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The little slime seems delighted and is attempting to mirror your motions as you dance. It begins to look weary though.
The little slime hovers over a bit of sludge and absorbs it, looking slightly rejuvenated.
It seems all of this dancing has tuckered it out. Perhaps someone in the Undercity canals sells more of this nutritious sludge?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The slime shudders with newfound energy. It seems to want to follow you, now that it has associated you with food.
